Name: APOPHIS
Notes and explanations:
astlo has an inbuilt rk4 intergrator. Use it to get refined states for any solarsystem object X.
Use astlo.vectors to work around the vectors in this file.
Use astlo.humanread to get full details including history,explorations,pictures,videos,scientific_facts for any Solar system object X.
The consumer of this file can manipulate the data by: plotting perifocal, 2D and 3D real-time visuals.
The Full astlo suite is best because the core version lacks some features that are required by valley.
Best practice is to run anything related to astlo in the Astlo-environment directory. This part of Valley that uses astlo included. The other parts of valley are universal meaning they can be run in any directory. If this part of valley that uses astlo is used in another directory/environment other than the stated one, the user will leave files everywhere.
Hence the stated environment as Best practice.
Astlo Space Systems, r/kenyaspacenerds
